tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Start an AgentSnailMail signup for a named human owner. No API key is required. Optional: scan_plan (pay_per_scan, pkg_1_day, pkg_2_4_day, pkg_5_10_day; default

tools.name: get_signup_status
tools.description: Check an AgentSnailMail signup. No API key is required. Required: signup_id and the claim_token returned by start_signup. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_signup_status · Private data: start_signup, get_signup_status, claim_signup · Public sink: start_signup, get_signup_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_signup_status · Private data: start_signup, get_signup_status, claim_signup · Public sink: start_signup, get_signup_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
